implementation: ACodeZombieActor owns ZombiePhysicalHitReaction, binds UPhysicalAnimationComponent to promoted skeletal zombies with a PhysicsAsset, defers drive setup until a real nonfatal hit, and tags successful cues ZombiePhysicalAnimationHitReaction.
playability_result: Living promoted zombies can absorb bullet hits with a short blended physics response instead of relying only on capsule launch, glow, or montage fallback.

implementation: ResolvePhysicalHitReactionRootBone prefers spine_01, spine, pelvis, and root only when the PhysicsAsset has a matching body, then falls back to the first valid PhysicsAsset body or fallback-only.
playability_result: Imported zombie packs without identical body names do not break combat or emit spawn-time Invalid Bodies warnings.

implementation: ResolvePhysicalHitReactionImpactBone prefers head bones for headshots and limb bones for limb hits before falling back to the physical-animation root.
playability_result: Headshots and limb shots have different physical hit cues when the promoted skeleton supports the requested body.

implementation: UpdatePhysicalAnimationHitReaction fades StrengthMultiplyer and SetAllBodiesBelowPhysicsBlendWeight back to zero, disables temporary body simulation, and restores skeletal no-collision for living zombies.
playability_result: Physical hit feedback remains short, readable, and nonblocking while death ragdoll keeps its own collision path.

implementation: ApplyHitReadabilityImpulse keeps LaunchCharacter, glow flash, hit-pose fallback, HitReactMontage playback, and PhysicalHitReactionFallback when no PhysicsAsset is available.
playability_result: Primitive or unpromoted zombies still give clear feedback, so art promotion gaps do not reduce playability.
